attchmntText: Non-applicability of Related Party Transactions Provisions of Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.
voiceSummary: Niraj Ispat Industries Limited informs the National Stock Exchange that it is not required to comply with the related party transaction provisions of Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. This non-applicability is based on the company meeting the criteria under Regulation 15(2). As of the financial year ended 31st March, 2026, the paid-up equity share capital was 0.60 Crore and the net worth was 15.93 Crores. These figures are below the thresholds of Rs. 10 Crores and Rs. 25 Crores respectively. Consequently, the company is exempt from these provisions for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. A certificate from a Practicing Company Secretary confirming this non-applicability has been enclosed with the communication. The notice was issued by Director Cum CEO Chaitanya Chaudhry, holding DIN 06813394, on 12-11-2026.

attchmntText: Niraj Ispat Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Niraj Ispat Industries Limited board approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The meeting was held on 12th November 2026. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 114 lakh compared to Rs. 2195 lakh in the previous year. Total assets stood at Rs. 9623 lakh as of 30th September 2026. Equity share capital is Rs. 6000 lakh with a face value of Rs. 10 per share. Earnings per share for the half year is Rs. 122.4. The limited review report by Sanjeev Anand and Associates states no material misstatements were found. Cash and cash equivalents are Rs. 84 lakh. Borrowings include non-current liabilities of Rs. 178 lakh and current borrowings of Rs. 2959 lakh. Trade payables are Rs. 9215 lakh. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange under the symbol Nirajispat.

attchmntText: Dear Sir/ Ma am,In terms of the requirements of Regulation 27(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the listed entity shall submit quarterly report on Corporate Governance. However, in terms of Regulation 15(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 the requirement of filing of Corporate Governance Report as prescribed under Regulation 27 of said regulation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 is not applicable to our Company.
